desktop_active.observation: Owner confirmed Active default, mutually exclusive lifecycle controls, truthful ordering, lifecycle actions, focus recovery, and exact-row Undo on the immutable desktop deployment.

desktop_applied.observation: Owner confirmed Applied view membership, newest applied ordering, semantic Applied times, Undo applied restoration, and persistent filters on the immutable desktop deployment.

desktop_dismissed.observation: Owner confirmed Dismissed view membership, newest dismissed ordering, semantic Dismissed times, and Restore behavior on the immutable desktop deployment.

desktop_filters.observation: Owner confirmed company and tier selections persist across lifecycle views and Active restores its prior score or newest ordering.

desktop_paging.observation: Owner confirmed stable Load more append, pending duplicate protection, automatic Active backfill, and truthful caught-up exhaustion.

narrow_width.observation: Owner confirmed the 390x844 layout retains wrapped controls, all nine horizontally reachable columns, usable row actions, and an in-viewport Undo notice.

keyboard_focus.observation: Owner confirmed visible keyboard focus across lifecycle controls, row actions, paging controls, resize handles, and the scroll region, with focus recovery after removal.

screen_reader_status.observation: Owner confirmed polite Undo and caught-up status announcements, alert semantics, approved action copy, and semantic lifecycle timestamps.

desktop_lifecycle.expected: Active is the default. Show applied immediately precedes Show dismissed; the controls are mutually exclusive and expose truthful aria-pressed state. Applied and Dismissed views use their lifecycle timestamps and newest-first ordering.
desktop_lifecycle.observation: Owner observed Active as the desktop default, Show applied immediately before Show dismissed, exclusive pressed states, and truthful lifecycle headings and newest ordering.

desktop_apply_vs_mark_applied.expected: Apply opens the external employer link and does not change lifecycle. Mark Applied immediately removes a different row from Active and is the only action that sets Applied.
desktop_apply_vs_mark_applied.observation: Owner observed Apply navigate without moving its row and Mark Applied move only the separately selected row into Applied.

desktop_undo_focus.expected: Mark Applied moves focus to the next row, previous row, or table region; shows 'Marked {job title} as applied.' for 10 seconds; and Undo restores the exact row with 'Moved back to Active.' Dismiss and Restore remain separate and reversible.
desktop_undo_focus.observation: Owner observed focus recover after row removal, the title-bound 10-second notice restore the exact row, and independent Dismiss and Restore behavior.

desktop_filters_order_time.expected: Company and tier selections persist across lifecycle changes. Active preserves its score/newest choice; Applied and Dismissed are fixed newest lifecycle time first. The header reads Posted, Applied, or Dismissed and each value is a semantic time.
desktop_filters_order_time.observation: Owner observed persistent company and tier selections, restored Active ordering, fixed newest lifecycle ordering, correct headers, and semantic time values.

desktop_load_more.expected: Load more appends without replacing, duplicating, reordering, or auto-scrolling existing rows. While pending it reads 'Loading more…' and cannot be activated twice.
desktop_load_more.observation: Owner observed Load more append rows without replacement, duplicates, reordering, or automatic scrolling, with Loading more… disabling repeat activation.

desktop_backfill_caught_up.expected: A successful Active removal automatically fills the open slot when another eligible row exists. Exhaustion visibly reports 'You're all caught up' and disables Load more.
desktop_backfill_caught_up.observation: Owner observed successful Active removal fill its slot when another row existed and final exhaustion show You're all caught up with Load more disabled.

desktop_resize_scroll.expected: All nine table columns remain present and horizontally scrollable. Resize handles work, Action remains usable, Mark Applied precedes Dismiss, and Apply remains a separate column/action.
desktop_resize_scroll.observation: Owner observed working resize handles and horizontal scrolling across all nine columns, with Mark Applied before Dismiss and Apply remaining separate.

narrow_controls_table.expected: Lifecycle and filters wrap with Show applied immediately before Show dismissed. All nine columns remain reachable by horizontal scrolling; there is no card layout or hidden Score, Apply, or Action column.
narrow_controls_table.observation: Owner observed wrapped controls in the approved order and reached all nine columns at 390x844 without a card layout or hidden Score, Apply, or Action column.

narrow_actions_undo.expected: Action labels wrap without clipping, coarse-pointer targets remain usable, and the bottom-center Undo notice fits within the viewport without covering its full width.
narrow_actions_undo.observation: Owner observed unclipped wrapping Action labels, usable coarse-pointer targets, and the bottom-center Undo notice fitting within 390x844.

keyboard_focus.expected: Lifecycle controls, row actions, Load more or Retry, resize handles, and the scroll region are keyboard reachable with visible focus. Focus never remains on a removed row.
keyboard_focus.observation: Owner keyboarded through the specified controls, handles, and scroll region with visible focus and confirmed removed rows did not retain focus.

live_regions_copy.expected: Undo and end-of-queue messages are polite status updates, encountered mutation failures are alerts, lifecycle descriptions and action labels use the approved exact copy, and lifecycle times are semantic.
live_regions_copy.observation: Owner observed polite status announcements, alert behavior, approved lifecycle and action copy, and semantic lifecycle times at both viewport sizes.

responsive_no_hidden_columns.expected: The same dense nine-column table remains available throughout resizing, with horizontal overflow and functional actions; no hidden-column, card, or mobile redesign appears.
responsive_no_hidden_columns.observation: Owner resized from desktop to 390x844 and observed the same dense nine-column table, horizontal overflow, and functional actions throughout.
